Bob Firo
Physical Therapist | MSc in Sports Psychology | BSc in Sports Science

Defeat Chronic Back Pain and Start Living Pain-Free!

Hi Everyone! 👋 I'm Bob Firo, a Physical Therapist with over 15 years of experience helping people globally uncover the root causes of their injuries, conquer their fears, and live pain-free.

I’ve developed a holistic approach to support individuals with chronic lower back pain—without relying on medications, injections, or surgery.

👉 Imagine transforming your life with a simple 20-minute daily routine designed to relieve pain and improve your quality of life.

If you're ready to take charge of your health and embrace a pain-free future, join me on this journey!

📅 Book your appointment now:
https://dublinsportsinjuryclinic.setmore.com

Let’s get started on your path to recovery! 💪
